text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Is this really a GII race?! In the prelude 
to the Spring Tenno Sho, a truly 
terrifying race has just unfolded!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "Haaah... haaah... haaah...!"

text_block_list.name: Man with Undercut
text_block_list.text: Incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Man with Undercut
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, incredible, incredible! The 
Twinkle Series right now is totally wild!!

text_block_list.name: Pierced Woman
text_block_list.text:
"...With these kids, they could even 
surpass Rudolf. Breaking the all-time GⅠ 
victory record wouldn't just be a dream!"

text_block_list.name: Pierced Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you think we could win the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe too?! With these 
powerhouse runners—we could reach a glory 
never before seen in Tracen Academy's 
history!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe... with 
that girl.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I guess that's something I never 
really thought about...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(...Still. If we can compete against each 
other like today...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(If we could strive together for a speed 
like today's—)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, amazing...☆ All the girls who ran 
today ended up shining so bright!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And at the center was—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Maya figured it out♪ In that case, 
Maya will also...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"If I run with Brian-san, I can become 
sparkly too, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eheh—♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days had passed since the Hanshin 
Daishoten that shook the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A piece of breaking news took the world by 
storm.

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
Breaking news. Narita Brian has announced 
that she will withdraw from the Tenno Sho 
(Spring) due to an injury.

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
"After the Hanshin Daishoten, she felt 
discomfort in her lower back, and detailed 
examinations revealed an abnormality in 
her hip joint."

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
She announced that she will prioritize 
recovering from her injury for the time 
being and refrain from entering races.

text_block_list.name: Customer outside Convenience Store A
text_block_list.text: No way, Brian got injured...

text_block_list.name: Customer outside Convenience Store B
text_block_list.text:
...I heard she's going in and out of the 
hospital for a while, so she won't be 
racing.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, so that means we won't get to see 
Lady Brian run anymore~?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Customer B
text_block_list.text:
And taking such a long break must mean 
it's a really severe injury...

text_block_list.name: Cafe Customer B
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Still, Brian will make a comeback! Without 
a doubt! Definitely!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Right! Her mental game is total monster 
tier too! Even at the Kikuka Sho, she was 
so strong that none of the anxiety or 
tension around her mattered at all!!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
I'll finish my rehab and be right back! 
Because—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: —Because they're our "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's been announced that Brian-chan will 
be bypassing the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...It is a bit regrettable. The day when 
we could compete for the pinnacle with all 
our might has been pushed further away.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Still, what we need to do remains the 
same!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The more races Brian-chan ran, the 
stronger she became.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Then I want to be strong too. And reach 
out for my dream."
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's push forward so we don't fall 
behind her!

Yeah, let's keep moving forward so we 
don't lose to her!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes. —Forward. To seize our dream.
